result.summary: The page is largely well-composed: header, search bar, category chips, promo banner, carousels and bottom navigation all render correctly. The only visual defect is in the bottom tab bar, where the 'Orders' tab lacks an icon while Home, Search and Profile each have one, leaving a misaligned label and an empty gap above it.

issues.description: In the bottom navigation bar, the 'Orders' tab shows only a text label with no icon, whereas the other three tabs (Home, Search, Profile) each display an icon above their label. This leaves an empty gap above 'Orders' and makes the tab bar look broken/inconsistent.
issues.suggestion: Add an orders icon (e.g., a receipt/bag icon) above the 'Orders' label, matching the size, stroke weight and inactive gray color of the Search and Profile icons.

issues.description: Because the 'Orders' tab has no icon, its label sits higher (vertically centered in the icon+label block) than the labels of the other tabs, breaking the baseline alignment of the tab bar text.
issues.suggestion: Once the missing icon is added, ensure all four tab labels share the same baseline and vertical spacing so the navigation row appears uniform.
